messages:
maria.a: Quick sales->CS handoff for Kestrel Dynamics (enterprise). Contract effective 2026-04-01, PO KD-9921 uploaded to Sales drive. Primary contact: Oliver Chen (oliver.chen@kestrel.ai).

maria.a: High-level ask: Private (VPC) deployment in eu-west-1, SAML SSO, Dedicated capacity target ~200 req/s peak; initial seed usage expected ~15-25 rps for 8 weeks. Legal added DPA and EU data residency clause.

maria.a: They requested a 60m product + SSO test in week 1 and a joint performance tuning session with Eng in week 3. Potential multi-region expansion after Q3.

sam.k: Agree. I'll be the CS relationship owner for onboarding and first 8 weeks. Assigning onboarding PM. :white_check_mark:

sam.k: Devin — can you lead onboarding PM tasks and coordinate infra tickets?

devin.p: I can take onboarding PM. Need IdP metadata, list of customer IPs for VPC peering, and customer infra contact. Also confirm if they want prod+staging or prod-only.

maria.a: Oliver confirmed prod+staging flow. He'll deliver IdP metadata and a network diagram by EOD tomorrow.

nina.se: Technical note: provisioning for Private + Dedicated GPUs ~2-3 weeks after receiving network details and billing approval. SAML attributes required: email and groups. Creating ENGINF ticket for firewall/routing: ENGINF-4821.

nina.se: Also: requested model is opt-7b-quant. We need to run quant profile validation on Dedicated infra — schedule perf smoke after staging deploy. Could be perf sensitive.

lee.support: I'll assemble a customer runbook (incident flow, escalation path, support SLAs, contact matrix). Can someone confirm L2/L3 POCs for the customer-facing runbook?

sam.k: L2 POC: lee.support; L3/Eng escalation: nina.se. I'll remain primary CS owner.

devin.p: Draft onboarding checklist (first pass):
- Schedule kickoff (60m) and send agenda
- Collect IdP metadata + test user
- Receive network diagram + firewall rules
- Provision Dedicated nodes in eu-west-1 (recommend 2x A100 to start)
- Deploy staging, run perf smoke tests (include opt-7b-quant validation)
- Conduct SSO test + product enablement session
- Publish runbook to secure customer folder

maria.a: Proposed kickoff: Tue 2026-04-06 10:00 CET. Oliver confirmed availability. Invite sent.

ops-bot: calendar-bot: Meeting created: "Kestrel Dynamics — Onboarding Kickoff" Tue 2026-04-06 10:00 CET. Guests: maria.a, sam.k, devin.p, nina.se, lee.support, oliver.chen@kestrel.ai

devin.p: I'll prep the kickoff agenda and share the doc by EOD Mon. Agenda will cover milestones, success criteria, deliverables, and feedback loop for early QA.

nina.se: Please add network artifacts to the secure share (not in Slack). Devin, if access not provisioned I'll open INF ticket. Also adding perf validation plan to ENGINF-4821.

devin.p: Creating secure folder now and inviting team + Oliver. Opening provisioning ticket PROV-76021.

lee.support: Support readiness: pre-configure monitoring alerts (token error spikes, latency > 500ms, 5xx rate > 0.5%). Configure traces and dashboards for the first 2 weeks. Draft runbook will include escalation timeline and rotation info.

maria.a: Billing note: committed monthly rate with 12-month term. Upsell: propose 6-month performance review for capacity expansion. Also customer asked about 1-year log retention for compliance; legal cleared the request but we need confirmation in deployment spec.

nina.se: Confirmed — 1-year retention is supported. I'll include retention settings and IAM permissions mapping in the deployment spec.

devin.p: Action owners & next steps:
- maria.a: verify PO & legal notes (done)
- oliver.chen (customer): send IdP metadata + network diagram (customer)
- devin.p: create secure folder + kickoff agenda (by EOD Mon)
- nina.se: open ENGINF-4821 and attach perf validation plan (today)
- lee.support: draft runbook + monitoring thresholds (tomorrow)
- sam.k: start weekly check-ins for 8 weeks (first check-in 1 week after kickoff)

sam.k: Risk log: provisioning delay if IdP/network docs are late; perf validation may surface need for larger capacity or different quant profile. I'll track and escalate on blockers.

maria.a: Customer also asked for a locked-down read-only eval environment for their security team. Can staging be configured for read-only access? @nina.se

nina.se: Yes, staging can be restricted for read-only evaluation. Need list of evaluator emails and will include ACLs in access controls doc.

devin.p: I'll collect evaluator list and upload to secure folder.

maria.a: Feedback capture: during the enablement session, we'll ask for a short questionnaire (UX, latency, integration pain points) and set a follow-up to review results in week 3 tuning session.

lee.support: I'll wire a feedback form and add it to the kickoff agenda; will also add a first-30-day checklist to the runbook.

sam.k: OK team — logging this in the handoff tracker and marking onboarding as "active". Update tracker when assigned tasks complete. :pray: 

maria.a: Thanks all — Devin I'll ping you offline if Oliver sends partial artifacts.

sam.k: Closing initial handoff message here. We'll reconvene after kickoff and post status updates.
